## Workload

Kofi Asante completed 488 reads during the quarter, recording 411 hours of work. This represents an average of 1.2 reads per hour. The workload was reviewed to confirm that the recorded activity and reading rate were appropriately reflected in the assessment.

## Quality

A further 46 reads were checked as part of the quality review. The level of agreement between the grader’s assessment and the reviewer’s assessment was 63.0 per cent. The grader and reviewer agreed that the current session pattern should continue.

The review was completed by Priya Anand.
